executivePulse.interpretation: The situation for memory and AI infrastructure remains strained. Server DRAM / RDIMM, HBM and enterprise SSDs are among the tightest areas. The Daily Check from 2026-08-21 examined 8 relevant current reports; there is currently no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can ease pressure, but will only reach the market with a time lag. For buyers, securing supply, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
